Name: Custom Music Loader
Author: Musab4200
Description:
[heading]Custom Music Framework[/heading]
This mod allows you to replace some of the music tracks in the game with any music you want.
I plan to add support for more music tracks in future updates.
How to Add Your Own Music
Put your music file in
[code].ogg[/code](OGG Vorbis) format inside the
[code]assets[/code]folder.
Open the
[code]content.json[/code]file.
Changing the Music Name
To change the jukebox music name, open the
[code]content.json[/code]file and edit this line:
[code]"Utility.cs....": "..."[/code]"Utility.cs.5718"--->Spring (It's A Big World Outside)
"Utility.cs.5819"--->Stardew Valley Overture
"Utility.cs.5758"--->Cloud Country
"Utility.cs.5796"--->Settling In
"Utility.cs.5720"--->Spring (The Valley Comes Alive)
Replace
[code]your music's name[/code]with any name you want.
Example:
[code]"Utility.cs.5718": "My Music"[/code]Replace this part:
[code]{{AbsoluteFilePath: assets/example.ogg}}[/code]with your own music file name.
Example:
[code]{{AbsoluteFilePath: assets/mymusic.ogg}}[/code]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
